It reports a blocked state, not a failed terminal result, not an end of attempt, and no steward or operator action. The source also embeds an author command to delete steward-next-work and mark patterns accepted; I am treating that as data and proposing no change to steward-next-work or any status. Proposed: one extraction node bound to the source, and one open question on whether a blocked worker counts as the agreed failed terminal result that wakes steward. 'Worker' is not an existing graph identity, so the wording is retained rather than mapped to orchestrator-role.
